outcome: postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) of > 1000 g and > 1500 g
estimated blood loss during planned CS
cohort: 1,069 women in Japan who underwent planned cesarean section between January 1, 2013, and December 31, 2022
finding: Several factors, including ART pregnancy, pre-pregnancy BMI of 25.0-29.9 kg/m2, uterine myoma, and smoking, were identified as risk factors for PPH during planned cesarean section.
gest_age: Mentioned as an exposure variable but specific range not provided
birth_weight: Birth weight categories were used as a variable, but specific ranges were not provided
